# Floating UI (vendored test fixture)

`floating-ui.dom.js` is `@floating-ui/dom@1.6.13` (`dist/floating-ui.dom.browser.min.mjs`) and
`floating-ui.core.js` is `@floating-ui/core@1.6.9` (`dist/floating-ui.core.browser.min.mjs`, which
bundles `@floating-ui/utils`), unmodified; the page maps `@floating-ui/core` with an import map. MIT (see `LICENSE`). Used only
by pageon's tests.
